message:
We recently had a surprise storm warning that sent our family group chat into a flurry of activity. 🌩️ My sister started sharing her go-bag checklist, while my brother reminded everyone to check their water supply. It was a mix of practical reminders and a few light-hearted jokes to keep the mood up, but it made me realize how much easier it is to prepare when we lean on each other. 

By the end of the chat, we all felt a little more ready and a lot more connected. It’s a gentle reminder that preparedness doesn’t have to be a solo mission — sometimes, just reaching out can make all the difference! What’s your favorite tip for keeping your family in the loop during emergencies?
